initial.question: For fixed closed genus g>=2 and fixed finite k>=3, show unbounded ambient Mod_g conjugacy multiplicity of pseudo-Anosov dilatations for representatives in I_g(k).
ownDerivations: Use shifted lower central indexing Γ_j=γ_{j+1}. Identity automorphisms at depth a move Γ_j elements by Γ_{a+j}, via commutator expansion and induction. For αx=xu βx=xv, modulo Γ_{a+b} the compositions reduce to xuv and xvu and agree. Outer actions adjusted by lifted inner conjugators. A separating twist conjugates one factor by boundary word in Γ1, hence at depth2. k fixed and nested terms apply.

Derivative matrices U=(1,μ;0,1), V=(1,0;−μ,1) for filling separating pair. [V,C] has upper-right −μq² and trace 2+μ²q². Recurrence q1=μ gives q_r=−μ^(2^r−1), trace2+μ^(2^r). Thus c_r at I(2r) hyperbolic. Its endpoints avoid 0 because offdiagonal q nonzero. Large parabolic conjugation by B^M moves each endpoint toward 0, ensuring disjoint endpoints. Powers give free convex-cocompact subimage, freeness makes lift injective on its chosen free generators.

Uniform fusion: K compact with JK=X, normalize one axis point x of u into K once. Any ambient hyperbolic conjugate v in J yields axis point t x in X. Translate by j in J back to K so j t in finite transporter of K. This bounds J-classes per G-class uniformly, with no arithmetic or injectivity on the full stabilizer. Pseudo-Anosov unique Teichmüller axis/disk must apply to all ambient conjugators between these elements. Invariant axis uniqueness plus a geodesic’s tangent determines the disk.

Horowitz stage W_j=(U^(−ε)yU^ε)^(2j) y^(2j−1)(U^(−ε)yU^ε)^(2j). Flip one sign: trace coordinates of (U^(−1)yU,y) and (UyU^(−1),y) agree by cyclic trace, so all later words share traces via rank-two trace polynomials. Cyclically reduced representative U^ε y^(2j−1) U^(−ε)y^(4j) has unique positive marker y^(2j−1) and y^(4j). Earlier raw words have lower exponent bounds and one positive odd top marker, so inversion and prior signs recover inductively. Free rank-two image lifts to SL(2,R) by generator lifts. Equal |trace| gives equal lengths then log dilatation; for m with 2^m≥CN, quotient by bounded ambient fusion.
No claim of simple or primitive length multiplicity, infinite multiplicity at one t, infinite filtration depth, or first solution.

exact_scope: At any fixed closed oriented genus g >= 2 and fixed finite depth k >= 3, for each N there exist N pseudo-Anosovs in that Johnson term, pairwise nonconjugate in the full orientation-preserving mapping class group, with equal dilatation. The common value may depend on N.
root_mathematics: The indexed centrality bound follows in Aut and then Out by correcting quotient-inner representatives. Both separating twists start in depth 2. The commutator recursion gives q_r = -mu^(2^r - 1) and trace 2 + mu^(2^r) for r >= 2, so prescribed finite depths have hyperbolic derivatives. A large parabolic translate separates the fixed point pairs; high powers give a Schottky subgroup with compact convex core. A single fixed point on a representative axis in a compact fundamental set normalizes every overgroup conjugacy into one finite transporter. Uniqueness of the invariant Teichmuller disk forces ambient conjugators to preserve it; only the Schottky subgroup map must be injective. Cyclic-word markers distinguish the Horowitz families, and three trace coordinates are unchanged by every sign flip. Equal trace of SL lifts gives equal dilatation and bounded fusion leaves arbitrarily many ambient classes.
